envelope.schemaVersion: Version of the dataset schema. Field names are stable; breaking changes bump the version.
envelope.generatedAt: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the response was serialized.
envelope.lastUpdated: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent record-level data change in this collection. Moves only when a record actually changes, never on rebuild alone.
envelope.methodology: URL of the Harpd Rank methodology page.
envelope.license: The dataset is published under CC BY 4.0.
envelope.count: Number of records in the collection.

excluded: Never included: user accounts or contact details, billing or processor identifiers, credential or secret material, internal review notes, private account fields, or any unapproved/hidden listing.

fields.id: Stable record identifier. Equal to the slug.
fields.name: Product display name.
fields.slug: Stable URL slug used in profile URLs.
fields.rank: Current position on the overall board.
fields.rankPoints: Current Harpd Rank Points (1 completed Credit = 1 permanent Rank Point).
fields.verified: True when Harpd has verified the product listing.
fields.updatedAt: Last public update timestamp for the record.

fields.productType: Public product type label, when provided.

fields.name: Category display name.
fields.productCount: Number of approved products in the category.
fields.rankedProductCount: Products in the category holding at least 1 Rank Point.
fields.totalRankPoints: Sum of Rank Points held by products in the category.
fields.state: "EMPTY" (no approved products), "LISTED_NO_RP" (products listed, none holding Rank Points) or "ACTIVE" (at least one Rank Point held). Distinguishes an empty board from a board with only free listings.
fields.topRankOpen: True while no product holds Rank Points, i.e. the #1 promotional position is unclaimed.
fields.createdAt: Earliest approval date observed on the board. Null for empty boards — not backfilled.
fields.updatedAt: Latest listing change observed on the board. Null for empty boards.
fields.categoryBoards: Envelope field: number of category boards Harpd operates.
fields.categoriesWithProducts: Envelope field: boards that currently hold at least one approved product. Always <= categoryBoards.

fields.productCount: Products recorded in the closed-period snapshot.

endpoints.record: rank record + profile fields + citation links

fields.movement: Human-readable movement label versus the previous period, when the board records one.
fields.previousRank: Position in the previous period, when known.
fields.alternativesUrl: Canonical Harpd alternatives page for this product.
fields.scope: Envelope field: always "overall-top-100" — the endpoint is capped at the public Top 100.

fields.totalRankPoints: Envelope field: Rank Points across the whole board.
fields.productShare: Category share of all listed products, in percent (one decimal).
fields.pointsShare: Category share of all Rank Points, in percent (one decimal).
fields.topProduct: Current category leader: name, slug, profile URL and Rank Points.
fields.totalProducts: Envelope field: products across the whole board.
fields.categoryCount: Envelope field: categories that currently hold at least one product.

fields.question: The question the page answers (its H1).
fields.bestBoardUrl: Best-intent only: the /best/{slug}/ board the answer is built from.
fields.summary: Concept-intent only: the authored direct answer text.

fields.slug: Comparison slug (alphabetically ordered pair, e.g. a-vs-b).
fields.category: Shared board category of both subjects.
fields.left: First subject: slug, name, profile URL, category, rank and Rank Points.
fields.updatedAt: Most recent record-level update across both subjects.

fields.name: Subject product display name.
fields.rank: Subject position on the overall board.
fields.alternatives: Same-category peers in Harpd Rank order: slug, name, profile URL, rank and Rank Points.

fields.monthKey: Closed UTC month the report covers (YYYY-MM).
